home_hero_desc: Just a solid community playing and chilling together. We're more than just a clan, we're family.
home_feat1_desc: Quality over quantity. We carefully select our members to ensure that everyone perfectly fits into our established culture.
home_feat2_desc: We stand together through every victory and defeat. No one gets left behind in the lobby, both in-game and out.
home_feat3_desc: Whether we're playing competitively or just hanging out in private servers, our main goal is always the same: having fun.
home_games_desc: These are the main arenas where our clan gathers to chill, practice, and dominate.
home_game1_desc: Run, slide, and revive! We spend countless hours dodging nextbots and saving teammates. It's all about speed and teamwork.
home_game2_desc: Reflexes and timing. This is our go-to competitive arena to show off our parry skills and climb the leaderboards.
home_game3_desc: When we want to take a break from Roblox, we jump into our own survival servers to build massive bases and chill.
home_game4_desc: When we want a good scare, we group up and dive into the scariest horror experiences Roblox has to offer.
home_moments_desc: A sneak peek into our best times together. Just vibes, laughs, and pure fun.
home_join_desc: Looking for a solid community to chill and play with? There's always an empty seat for you here.
members_desc: Meet the family. The people who make this clan feel like home.
gallery_desc: A collection of our best moments, random screenshots, and memories we've made together.
rules_desc: Strict rules that must be obeyed by all members of the 4Fun Clan. Violating these rules can result in fatal consequences.

rules_list.title: No Racism
rules_list.description: Everyone here is equal, regardless of where they are from. Anyone being racist will get an automatic warning.

rules_list.title: No NSFW / 18+ Topics
rules_list.description: Do not discuss adult topics, send inappropriate pictures, or weird links. This server is for chilling, not for 'those' things.

rules_list.title: No Spam
rules_list.description: Do not spam the chat, emojis, Voice Channels, or mention people without reason. Be considerate of others whose messages might get drowned out.

rules_list.title: Respect Privacy
rules_list.description: Do not pry into or share other people's personal information without permission. Privacy is important, not everything is meant for public consumption.

rules_list.title: Keep It Friendly & Safe
rules_list.description: Avoid topics that are too personal, sensitive, or could make others uncomfortable. Focus on server related topics so everyone feels at home.

rules_list.title: Communication
rules_list.description: If there are any problems or important information regarding the clan whether it's an issue with another member, changing your Roblox display name, or wanting to leave, you are required to inform the admins to avoid misunderstandings.

rules_list.title: No Hode / Gay
rules_list.description: You already know what this means...

rules_list.title: No False Accusations
rules_list.description: Do not assume you are being ignored or left out of circles without any solid proof.

rules_list.title: No Double Clan
rules_list.description: You cannot be in 2 clans simultaneously. (e.g., 4Akeno67clan).
